     ```
     OOZIE-609 OOZIE-609 Oozie services fail to start with log enabled. (tucu)
     ```

The changes in `Services.java` enhance the logging mechanism by modifying how log messages are formatted when loading and replacing services. This is directly related to the issue addressed in OOZIE-609, which is recorded in the `release-log.txt` file. Specifically, the bug fix improves debug logging functionality to ensure that the services can start properly when logging is enabled. The updates reflect an improvement in the codebase to support better logging practices while addressing the underlying defect described in the release log.
